notes: Unlike the brief's expectation, the fetch module reached ectorcountytx.gov (status 200) for the elections page and four result PDFs; the legacy URL www.co.ector.tx.us/page/ector.elections also returned the same new-site content. The elections page is an archive of county-hosted PDFs (CivicPlus DocumentCenter). Nov 5 2024 section lists 'UNOFFICIAL VOTING TOTALS (PDF)', 'OFFICIAL CUMULATIVE RESULTS (PDF)', 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT RESULTS (PDF)' and 'PRELIMINARY ELECTION RECONCILIATION-UNOFFICIAL TOTALS (PDF)'. The unofficial totals PDF is a county-wide 'Cumulative Results Report ... Unofficial Results', 'Run Time 12:22 AM', 'Run Date 11/06/2024', 'Precincts Reporting 55 of 55 = 100.00%', i.e. the election-night final county total. The only precinct-level report posted is headed 'Precinct Results Report ... Official Results', 'Run Time 1:00 PM', 'Run Date 11/13/2024', i.e. generated a week after election day at canvass time. For the Mar 3 2026 primary the page lists only 'Official results for the joint primary election (PDF)', a county-wide 'Cumulative Results Report ... Official Results' run 03/10/2026 9:04 AM, and no precinct-by-precinct report. For the May 26 2026 runoff the page lists only 'CUMULATIVE FINAL RESULTS' PDFs per party (county-wide) and no precinct report. Caveats: run dates timestamp report generation, not posting; the archive shows what is retained today, so an unofficial election-night precinct report could have been posted and later replaced, which is why confidence is med rather than high. The May 3 2025 election (outside scope) also shows 'Official Precinct by Precinct Results (PDF)'. A search result title 'Cumulative Results Report ECTOR COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results' at co.ector.tx.us (UNOFFICIAL EARLY VOTING TOTALS 11.05.24.pdf) is consistent with county-level election-night reporting. The page also links a 'Central Counting Live Stream' for May 2025. Phone and email are from the county Elections page Contact Us block ('Phone: 432-498-4030'; 'Email Elections Office' link, Cloudflare-obfuscated, decoded to elections.office@ectorcountytx.gov; administrator Lisa Sertuche). Wayback probe for co.ector.tx.us/upload/page/7873/docs/Elections/ failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). No WebFetch attempted. No 2025 or 2026 stated change to precinct-level reporting found. Usage notice: none seen on the page, left empty. Network note: the Ector fetches above succeeded at about 14:05 UTC, just before the orchestrator reported the network opening (about 14:07 UTC); robots.txt for ectorcountytx.gov returned 200 then. TX SOS county election officials list (fetched after the network opened) confirms Elections Administrator Elizabeth 'Lisa' Sertuche, 1010 E. 8th St., Suite 101, Odessa, (432) 498-4030, County Email Address mailto elizabeth.sertuche@ectorcountytx.gov (the administrator's address; the office inbox elections.office@ectorcountytx.gov from the county page is used here). Wayback availability API (archive.org/wayback/available via fetch module, 9 queries at 4-hour points across the three windows) for ectorcountytx.gov/271/Elections returned closest snapshot 20260730142348 for every window (one query returned none), far outside the windows, so no usable capture. Ector DocumentCenter responses carry a dynamic Last-Modified (time of request), so they give no upload times.
tag_rationale: County documents show Nov 5 2024 election-night unofficial results were county-wide only (run 11/06/2024 12:22 AM) and the only precinct report is marked Official Results with run date 11/13/2024; the 2026 primary and runoff show only county-wide cumulative reports. This fits county totals on election night with precinct detail at canvass.
